profile.name: DDS信号源
profile.description: 基于直接数字合成的可编程信号源，可按实验时序设置输出的频率、幅度和相位，并可通过数字门控实现开关和脉冲输出。常用于原子物理、量子光学和精密测量实验中的AOM/EOM驱动、本振提供和相干控制。
profile.description_en: A direct-digital-synthesis signal source with programmable frequency, amplitude, and phase, often with digital gating for on/off control and timed pulses. It is commonly used in atomic physics, quantum optics, and precision measurement experiments for AOM/EOM driving, local oscillator generation, and coherent control.

registry.name: DDS Frequency/Phase/Amplitude
registry.description: DDS Frequency/Phase/Amplitude是一款表征设备，主要功能包括使能、关闭、打开、禁用、触发。支持Signal, Slot, add device等操作。
